title: release-engineering-weekly-notes-2026-03-31
content:
Release Engineering Weekly Notes - 2026-03-31

Attendees: Aisha Khan (owner), Tomás Rivera, Priya Menon, Ethan Li, Maya Patel (SRE), Jonah Brooks (QA)
Absentees: N/A

Meeting length: 45m

Agenda:
- Current release trains status (v1.42, v1.43)
- Hotfixes and emergency releases
- Change log review for this week
- Outstanding blockers and rollout mitigation plans
- Action items and owners

Notes:

1) Release trains
- v1.42 (staging -> canary next Tue): target rollout window Tue 2026-04-06 02:00-06:00 UTC.
  - Includes: batching improvements (PR 892), kernel selector tweaks for A100/MI250, and updated autoscale policy.
  - Risk: minor latency regression observed in internal perf tests for seq_len=4096 microbench on p4d. Root cause appears to be new kernel fallback for masked attention.
  - Mitigation: revert fallback path for p4d in canary if regression > 8% p99. Jonah to run focused perf suite (RE-1245).
  - Dependencies: infra needs node image build by 2026-04-03 (Tomás).

- v1.43 (feature freeze): scheduled for 2026-04-20.
  - Will bundle quantization profiles and KV cache hot-swap feature.
  - Request from product: hold off on API surface changes until after v1.43. Noted.

2) Hotfixes
- Hotfix deployed 2026-03-29 -> patch for logging regression causing large log volume in dedicated customers.
  - Root cause: missing size cap in access logger. Patch reverted noisy logs. Verified with customer X.
  - Postmortem in progress (owner: Priya). Draft due 2026-04-02.

- Proposed emergency hotfix: memory leak detected on private deployments running v1.41.
  - Repro steps documented in RE-1278.
  - Action: create patch branch and run stress test matrix on on-prem kit (Ethan + Maya). ETA 2026-04-02. If confirmed, schedule hotfix release 2026-04-03 01:00 UTC.

3) Change log review
- This week entries to include:
  - FIX: access logger size cap to reduce excessive disk usage (2026-03-29 hotfix).
  - IMPROVEMENT: improved kernel selection heuristics for long-seq workloads (v1.42).
  - NEW: autoscale burst capacity flag (beta) - documented in console rollout notes.
  - NOTE: experimental KV cache hot-swap is behind feature flag; not enabled by default.

- Reminder: maintainers, please add brief test coverage notes to change log entries (who validated, perf numbers if applicable).

4) Outstanding blockers
- Perf regression on p4d for v1.42 (see above). Severity: medium.
  - Owner: Jonah. Blocker until p99 numbers are back within SLO.

- Node image build flakiness in release CI (intermittent network failures pulling base images).
  - Owner: Tomás to add retry logic and mirror fallback. ETA 2026-04-03.

- Onprem memory leak triage blocked by limited repro infra.
  - Owner: Ethan to coordinate with customer success to schedule repro window.

5) Rollout and canary policy reminders
- Canary percentages: default 5% traffic for 24h, increase to 25% for 6h if no regressions, full rollout after 48h and no critical alerts.
- Emergency rollback checklist reviewed: automated rollback if error rate > 2x baseline for 15min, manual rollback if any P1 customer impact reported.

6) Observability / telemetry
- Console: new per-route token breakdown dashboard in staging. Feedback needed from product on naming.
- Tracing: sampling for background jobs lowered to 1% to reduce storage; retained traces for errors only.

Action items
- Jonah: run focused perf suite on p4d for seq_len=4096 and isolate kernel fallback cause. Due 2026-04-02. (RE-1245)
- Tomás: complete node image build fixes + add mirror fallback. Due 2026-04-03.
- Priya: finish hotfix postmortem draft for 2026-03-29 logging issue. Due 2026-04-02.
- Ethan & Maya: repro memory leak on on-prem kit and prepare patch branch if confirmed. Run stress tests. Due 2026-04-02. (RE-1278)
- Aisha: draft release notes for v1.42 and circulate to product/comms by 2026-04-05.

Parking lot / follow-ups
- Evaluate enabling autoscale burst capacity for dedicated customers (product + SRE sync next week).
- Decide on default behavior for KV cache hot-swap after initial canary results.

Meeting takeaways (TL;DR)
- v1.42 on track but watch a p4d perf regression; canary contingent on perf fix.
- Logging hotfix resolved customer impact; postmortem in progress.
- Potential on-prem memory leak needs repro; hotfix if confirmed.

Next meeting: 2026-04-07 10:00 UTC
